data.ruling: The refutation does not hold. The stock verifier's only failed check, "end-of-life notices", failed on agreement, not on the gate. The P4 record said "PCN: not read" and the verifier then read the available sources. Its own check says passes: true, and its read found no end-of-life or last-time-buy notice. The Lifecycle check gate for change and discontinuation notices is "any end-of-life notice fails". The source is the manufacturer's PCN (product change notice) listing "where public". ROHM publishes no PCN listing on www.rohm.com, so that listing is not read: it is not public. Every source that is readable shows no notice. I re-read each one. The ROHM product page gives Status Active and names no PCN, discontinuation or NRND (not recommended for new designs) notice. The ROHM sales support page names only Rochester Electronics as a reseller of discontinued products and carries no PCN listing. Digi-Key reports ProductStatus Active, discontinued false and end_of_life false. Status Active passes S5, which is "active only; preview fails; a longevity commitment is recorded and not required" (owner, 2026-09-25). The verifier's two other disagreements, longevity commitment and market introduction, filled in fields the record had as not read, and both pass. No published longevity commitment is recorded as such and is not a gate under S5. The first datasheet revision is Rev.001 of 05 Dec 2012, and Rev.002 of 15 Jan 2013 added the FP3 parts. That is over 12 months on the market, so nothing is flagged. Stock at JLCPCB (3170, presale 3067) and at Digi-Key (3618) both pass the rule-4 gate of 50. The datasheet verifier confirmed every requirement value. The part stays for load-cell excitation. The record should have its "PCN: not read" replaced by "no end-of-life notice found; ROHM's PCN listing not public". The scope is part because the refutation is about a discontinuation notice, which would fail the part in every function.

JLCPCB API, 2026-09-28T16:09:47Z: exact match C308595, BD450M2FP3-CE2, maker label ROHM Semicon, SOT-223-4(F), stockCount 3170, canPresaleNumber 3067, library type expand, other_results 0.
Gates at checkout c25aa863372d: Research.md Lifecycle check "Change and discontinuation notices | the manufacturer's PCN listing, where public | any end-of-life notice fails". S5 Answer: "active only; preview fails; a longevity commitment is recorded and not required (owner, 2026-09-25)". S4: 5 × need, never under 50. Need is 5 boards × 1 placement = 5, so the gate is 50.
Not re-read by me: ROHM's longevity programme list and its 2025 cancellation list (the verifier read them at 15:57:28Z and 15:57:47Z), and the datasheet revision history (the verifier read it at 15:58:09Z). Neither can turn the ruling, because S5 requires no commitment and the part has been on the market for more than 12 months.
